div.div:
LACP Aggregation Specs (802.3ad)
• Protocol: LACP (mode active on both ends)
• Bundling: 2x 100Mbps / 1Gbps member links
• Failover: Single link failure causes 0s packet drop
• Trunk Encapsulation: Dot1Q with Native VLAN 999

• Mode: spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
• Edge Ports: portfast & bpduguard enable
• Root Election: Deterministic via priority values
• Failover Recovery: Validated <2.0s transition time
